_README: Per-OS action map for gallery-perf-probe.mjs / gallery-input-probe.py. Keyed by osKey (service name minus 'osgallery-' prefix and '-N' suffix; doubled tokens like os2warp-os2warp collapse to os2warp). Fields: win = X window to activate ('qemu' class, or 'name:FreeRDP'); mouse.a/mouse.b = two X:99 coords inside the guest content to move the cursor between (must land on rendered guest pixels; console/text OSes have no cursor -> mouse=N/A, expect misses); kbd = xdotool arg ('super','ctrl+Escape', or 'type:X'); kbd_reset = key(s) to restore baseline (joined with '+space+' for multiple); audio_trigger = 'tone' (paplay a 440Hz sine into the neko-captured sink audio_output; OS-agnostic; measures neko-encode+transport continuity) or 'guest:<cmd>' or 'none'. The audio DEVICE (sb16/ac97/hda/none) is auto-detected live from the QEMU cmdline; this file only carries input hints. 'validated:true' = numbers captured this run.
